framework: Income-tax Act, 2025 (advance tax schedule carried forward; Finance Act 2026)
notes: Finance Act 2026 made no change to the ₹10,000 advance tax threshold or the quarterly instalment schedule. Advance tax is payable when estimated annual tax liability after TDS/TCS exceeds ₹10,000. Instalments are due quarterly for non-corporate taxpayers.
assumptions: Applicable to individual resident taxpayers whose estimated total income tax liability for the financial year (after deducting TDS and TCS) exceeds ₹10,000.
Follows the quarterly statutory schedule for non-corporate taxpayers: 15% by 15 June, 45% by 15 September, 75% by 15 December, and 100% by 15 March.
limitations: Resident senior citizens (aged 60 years or older) having no business or professional income are entirely exempt from advance tax.
Does not calculate penal interest for default in payment of advance tax or for deferment of instalments.
Eligible presumptive taxation assessees paying 100% advance tax in a single installment by 15 March are not modeled.
Estimated schedule for planning purposes; consult official CBDT challan guidelines for tax deposit via e-Pay Tax.
disclaimer: This calculator uses the rules/data published by Income Tax Department for FY 2026-27 (TY 2026-27). Estimated result based on the inputs and assumptions provided. Educational tool only; not legal or filing advice. Check official guidance for your specific situation.
